topic: Data transfer for Brazil frequency model
summary_markdown: Someone requested the data for Brazil from 'Прода' to be copied onto the staging environment. The specific company numbers required were 7885 Brasil JCD and 7887 Brasil CC. This data is needed so that someone can calculate a new frequency model, ensuring that beta data remains untouched.
decisions: Data for Brazil (company numbers 7885 Brasil JCD and 7887 Brasil CC) will be copied to the staging environment.
